- Total net sales for FY2017: $177,866 million

The formula for year-over-year change in revenue is:

\[
\text{Year-over-Year Change (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{FY2017 Revenue} - \text{FY2016 Revenue}}{\text{FY2016 Revenue}} \right) \times 100
\]

Substituting the values:

\[
\text{Year-over-Year Change (\%)} = \left( \frac{177,866 - 135,987}{135,987} \right) \times 100
\]

Calculating the difference:

\[
177,866 - 135,987 = 41,879
\]

Now, divide by FY2016 revenue:

\[
\frac{41,879}{135,987} \approx 0.307
\]

Now, multiply by 100 to convert to percentage:

\[
0.307 \times 100 \approx 30.7\%
\]

Thus, the year-over-year change in revenue from FY2016 to FY2017 is approximately **30.7%**.
